raw_segments.text: King Henry. We do not mean the coursing snatchers only, but fear the main
intendment of the Scott, who have been still a giddy neighbor to us. For you
shall read that my great-grandfather never went with his forces into France,
but that the Scott on his unfurnished kingdom came pouring, like the tide into
a breach, with ample and brim fullness of his force, galling the gleaned land with
hot assays, girdling with grievous siege castles and towns. That England, being
empty of defense, hath shook and trembled at the ill neighborhood.
